subject: general
question:
If the marks scored by the students in a class test out of 50 then, Find the Median of the following data:

 

 
 

 **Marks**
 **Frequency**
 
 

 0-10
 5
 
 

 10-20
 8
 
 

 20-30
 6
 
 

 30-40
 6
 
 

 40-50
 5
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total frequency N = 30, so N/2 = 15.

Cumulative frequency crosses 15 in the 20-30 interval (5 + 8 = 13, then 13 + 6 = 19).

Directly apply: Median = Lower limit + [ (N/2 − cf) ÷ f ] × h

Median = 20 + [ (15 − 13) ÷ 6 ] × 10

Median = 20 + 3.33 = 23.33

**∴ The correct answer is 23.3 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total frequency (N) = 5 + 8 + 6 + 6 + 5 = 30

Value of N/2 = 30 ÷ 2 = 15

**Finding Cumulative Frequencies (cf):**

⇒ 0-10: 5

⇒ 10-20: 5 + 8 = 13

⇒ 20-30: 13 + 6 = 19 (This is the median class since cf ≥ 15)

⇒ 30-40: 19 + 6 = 25

⇒ 40-50: 25 + 5 = 30

**Formula Used:**

Median = L + [ (N/2 − cf) ÷ f ] × h

Where L = Lower limit of median class = 20

cf = Cumulative frequency of preceding class = 13

f = Frequency of median class = 6

h = Class width = 10

**Calculation:**

⇒ Median = 20 + [ (15 − 13) ÷ 6 ] × 10

⇒ Median = 20 + (2 ÷ 6) × 10

⇒ Median = 20 + 10 ÷ 3

⇒ Median = 20 + 3.33

⇒ Median = 23.33

**∴ The correct answer is 23.3 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mode of Grouped Data

Mode = L + [ (f₁ − f₀) ÷ (2 × f₁ − f₀ − f₂) ] × h, where f₁ is the frequency of the modal class, f₀ is the frequency of the preceding class, and f₂ is the frequency of the succeeding class.

Mean of Grouped Data

Mean = (Σfᵢxᵢ) ÷ Σfᵢ, where xᵢ represents the class marks (midpoints) of the respective intervals.

Empirical Relationship

In a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship between measures of central tendency is: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
